```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(units)
```

```{r load-data}
source(here("R", "00-config.R"))

# load(here("output", "figs", "figure_inputs.rda"))
cluster_dat <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "cluster_dat.rds"))
districts_tib <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "districts_tib.rds"))
amhara_shp <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "amhara_shp.rds"))

eth1_shp <- st_read(here("data", "eth_admin_boundaries", "eth_admin1.shp"))

morans_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "morans_i_results.rds"))
spatial_preds <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "spatial_preds.rds"))
```

```{r prev-figs-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pad_frac_bottom <- 0.2

# --- District geometry + fixed layout meta (shared across all markers) ----
district_meta_base <- districts_tib %>%
  mutate(
    boundary = map(district_shp, ~ amhara_shp %>%
                     filter(adm3_name == .x) %>%
                     dplyr::select(geometry) %>%
                     sf::st_transform(4326)),
    bb = map(boundary, sf::st_bbox),
    xlim = map(bb, ~ c(.x[["xmin"]], .x[["xmax"]])),
    ylim = map(bb, ~ c(.x[["ymin"]], .x[["ymax"]])),
    ylim_padded = map(ylim, ~ {
      yrng <- diff(.x)
      c(.x[1] - pad_frac_bottom * yrng, .x[2])
    })
  )

# Fixed annotation placement (shared across markers; only text changes)
district_meta_base <- district_meta_base %>%
  mutate(
    x = case_when(
      district %in% c("Metema", "Machakel", "Debay Tilatgin",
                      "Fogera", "Tach Gaynt", "Bibugn") ~ -Inf,
      district %in% c("Ebinat", "Fagita Lekoma",
                      "Goncha", "Albuko",
                      "Debre Birhan Town", "Woreta Town") ~ Inf,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    y = case_when(
      district %in% c("Metema", "Ebinat", "Fagita Lekoma",
                      "Goncha", "Debay Tilatgin",
                      "Debre Birhan Town", "Tach Gaynt",
                      "Fogera", "Albuko", "Woreta Town") ~ -Inf,
      district %in% c("Machakel", "Bibugn") ~ Inf,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    hjust = case_when(
      x == Inf & y == -Inf ~ 1,
      x == Inf & y == Inf ~ 1,
      x == -Inf & y == -Inf ~ 0,
      x == -Inf & y == Inf ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    vjust = case_when(
      x == Inf & y == -Inf ~ 0,
      x == Inf & y == Inf ~ 1,
      x == -Inf & y == -Inf ~ 0,
      x == -Inf & y == Inf ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Handy lookup lists (shared)
boundary_by_dist <- set_names(district_meta_base$boundary, district_meta_base$district)
xlim_by_dist     <- set_names(district_meta_base$xlim, district_meta_base$district)
ylim_by_dist     <- set_names(district_meta_base$ylim_padded, district_meta_base$district)

# ---- Marker-specific helpers ----

get_morans_for_marker <- function(marker_name) {
  morans_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(k == 5, marker == marker_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(district, morans_I, p_value) %>%
    mutate(
      moran_txt = paste0(
        "I = ", round(morans_I, 2), "\n",
        "p = ", signif(p_value, 2), "\n\n"
      )
    )
}

make_marker_points_sf <- function(marker_name) {
  cluster_dat %>%
    filter(marker == marker_name) %>%
    transmute(lon, lat, prev_perc) %>%
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
}

get_points_in_boundary <- function(boundary_sf, pts_sf) {
  inside <- sf::st_within(pts_sf, boundary_sf, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
  pts_sf[inside, , drop = FALSE]
}

make_preds_by_dist <- function(marker_name) {
  spatial_preds %>%
    dplyr::select(district, marker, predictions) %>%
    filter(marker == marker_name) %>%
    filter(!map_lgl(predictions, is.null)) %>%
    mutate(predictions = map(predictions, ~ dplyr::select(.x, -any_of(c("district", "marker"))))) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(predictions, keep_empty = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(value = pmin(pmax(value, 0), 1) * 100) %>%
    group_by(district) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
    set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(unique(.x$district))[1]))
}

get_preds_factory <- function(preds_by_dist) {
  function(dist) {
    idx <- match(dist, names(preds_by_dist))
    if (!is.na(idx)) preds_by_dist[[idx]] else tibble(x = numeric(), y = numeric(), value = numeric())
  }
}
```

```{r prev-figs-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Shared theme + coord helper (unchanged)
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 2)),
    plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3),

    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.ticks = element_blank()
  )

coord_for_dist <- function(dist) {
  coord_sf(
    crs = 4326,
    xlim = xlim_by_dist[[dist]],
    ylim = ylim_by_dist[[dist]],
    expand = FALSE,
    clip = "on"
  )
}

scale_bar <- ggspatial::annotation_scale(
  style = "bar",
  location = "br",
  width_hint = 0.2,
  pad_y = unit(0.02, "npc"),
  pad_x = unit(0.02, "npc")
)

build_spatial_figure_for_marker <- function(marker_name) {

  # marker-specific objects
  morans_marker <- get_morans_for_marker(marker_name)

  district_meta <- district_meta_base %>%
    left_join(morans_marker, by = join_by(district)) %>%
    mutate(
      moran_txt = if_else(is.na(moran_txt), "", moran_txt) # keep empty if missing
    )
  
  name_str <- ifelse(marker_name == "Pgp3", "Seroprevalence (%)", "Prevalence (%)")

  pts_sf <- make_marker_points_sf(marker_name)
  preds_by_dist <- make_preds_by_dist(marker_name)
  get_preds <- get_preds_factory(preds_by_dist)

  make_prev_plot <- function(dist) {
    boundary <- boundary_by_dist[[dist]]
    pts <- get_points_in_boundary(boundary, pts_sf)

    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_point(
        data = pts,
        aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = prev_perc, fill = prev_perc),
        pch = 21, alpha = 0.6
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = district_meta %>% filter(district == !!dist),
        aes(x = x, y = y, label = moran_txt, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
        size = 2.5, lineheight = 0.9
      ) +
      coord_for_dist(dist) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "D", direction = 1,
        limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
        name = name_str,
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          direction = "horizontal", label.position = "bottom",
          ticks = FALSE, barheight = unit(8, "pt"), barwidth = unit(100, "pt")
        )
      ) +
      scale_size_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 100), range = c(0.5, 6),
        name = name_str,
        guide = guide_legend(
          direction = "horizontal", label.position = "bottom",
          title.position = "top", keywidth = unit(15, "pt"),
          keyheight = unit(8, "pt"),
          override.aes = list(fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.6, pch = 21)
        )
      ) +
      base_theme +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      scale_bar +
      guides(fill = "none", size = "none")
  }

  make_pred_plot <- function(dist, show_legend = FALSE) {
    boundary <- boundary_by_dist[[dist]]
    pts <- get_points_in_boundary(boundary, pts_sf) %>% transmute(lon, lat)
    preds <- get_preds(dist)

    raster_or_fill <- if (nrow(preds) > 0) {
      list(
        geom_raster(data = preds, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value), interpolate = FALSE),
        geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
      )
    } else {
      list(
        geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = "grey75", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
      )
    }

    p <- ggplot() +
      raster_or_fill +
      geom_point(
        data = pts, aes(x = lon, y = lat),
        pch = 20, size = 0.5, color = "white", alpha = 0.6
      ) +
      coord_for_dist(dist) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "D", direction = 1,
        limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
        name = name_str,
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          direction = "horizontal", label.position = "bottom",
          ticks = FALSE, barheight = unit(8, "pt"), barwidth = unit(100, "pt")
        )
      ) +
      base_theme +
      scale_bar

    if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
    p
  }

  # Build paired panels (same as your logic)
  spacer <- plot_spacer() + theme_minimal()

  district_pairs <- imap(districts_tib$district, function(dist, i) {

    p_prev <- make_prev_plot(dist)
    p_pred <- make_pred_plot(dist, show_legend = FALSE)

    pair <- plot_grid(
      p_prev, p_pred,
      nrow = 1,
      align = "hv",
      axis = "tblr",
      rel_widths = c(1, 1)
    )

    title <- ggdraw() +
      draw_label(dist, fontface = "plain", size = 10, hjust = 0.5)

    plot_grid(
      title,
      pair,
      spacer,
      ncol = 1,
      rel_heights = c(0.12, 1, 0.02)
    )
  })

  # Legend from first district prediction plot (marker-specific but identical styling)
  legend_plot <- make_pred_plot(districts_tib$district[[1]], show_legend = TRUE) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 12)),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)

  legend_row <- plot_grid(
    spacer, legend, spacer,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(0.2, 1, 0.2)
  )

  # Assemble rows (3 districts per row, with gap columns)
  rows <- map(
    split(district_pairs, ceiling(seq_along(district_pairs) / 3)),
    ~ plot_grid(
      .x[[1]],
      spacer,
      .x[[2]],
      spacer,
      .x[[3]],
      nrow = 1,
      rel_widths = c(1, 0.10, 1, 0.10, 1),
      align = "hv"
    )
  )

  panels <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = rows,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "hv"
  )

  fig <- plot_grid(
    panels,
    legend_row,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.1)
  )

  list(fig = fig, spacer = spacer)
}
```
